positions.title: Software Engineer, Android
positions.description: Contributed to the Target Android application, focusing on digital grocery and same day services, such as Same Day Delivery, order pickup, and drive up. Key technologies include Android, Kotlin, rxJava, Dagger, and Espresso UI testing.

positions.title: Software Engineer (TLP) Rotational Program
positions.description:
During the first 6 month rotation, worked on the Target Android application to help develop the new shopping list feature and improve the barcode scanner, using Kotlin and rxJava.

For the second rotation, worked on Target’s cart and checkout platform APIs as well as the new Shipt (a same day delivery company acquired by Target) integration, leveraging technologies such as Kotlin,  ratpack, and elasticsearch.

positions.title: Software Engineering Intern
positions.description:
- Built a web application using Java Springboot and AngularJS to optimize asset management, improve search capabilities, and ultimately provide CGI support  for Target digital marketing teams.
- Created spell check and infinite scroll features by leveraging SolR database configurations and Material Design components to facilitate reuse of assets for product end users.

positions.title: Research Assistant - Data Analyst
positions.description: Assisted Berkeley Laboratory scientists in computer-based collection and analysis of experimental data for research on sustainable energy, such as the development of lithium-ion batteries for use in electric vehicles.

positions.title: Software Engineering Intern
positions.description:
-	Streamlined data collection and analysis for marketing manager through the creation of a user-friendly web application, overseeing development every step of the way through user manuals and progress reports.
-	 Facilitated architectural, financial, and marketing services for a large, nation-wide nonprofit by maintaining databases, programming scripting projects, 3D printing, and designing user interfaces.

positions.title: Computer Science Lab Assistant
positions.description: Instructed and tutored students in topics such as Python, Scheme, Java and SQL who needed help during or after class or have questions about labs, projects, tests, homework, or general concepts.

volunteerExperiences.description:
- Oversee and manage the board of directors in charge of the organization's event programming.
- Organize the Overnight Stay Program, a two-day parallel program for over 400 prospective students and parents to learn about campus resources, visit classes, stay in a dorm, and experience life at UC Berkeley.

volunteerExperiences.role: Alumni Events Director | Volunteer & Membership Coordinator
volunteerExperiences.description:
- Planned and executed the Overnight Stay Program, an event for over 400 prospective students and parents to experience life at UC Berkeley.
- Organized the organization's annual networking events, including an informal lunch for 200 students to meet alumni in a low-pressure environment, and a formal dinner for 60 highly-achieving guests to connect over career experiences.
- Worked with event planning committees to staff networking events and host a year-long mentoring program for nearly 100 first and second year students to be guided through the beginning of their Cal career.
